arguments.need: I have a big pile of scanned paper documents and the PDFs I make from them are huge and I can't search the text inside. I want a tool that shrinks scanned pages into compact PDFs by handling the text and the colored background separately, and that adds a hidden recognized-text layer so I can search and copy words. I'd like both a point-and-click window and a terminal command so I can script batches later.
